text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
情報によると、目的の場所は
この辺りのはずです。なんでも――
text.official_en:
My information suggests we have drawn quite near
our objective.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
禁断の地を覆うように巨大な壁が築かれ
あらゆるものの出入りを拒んでいるとか。
text.official_en:
All that I have gleaned suggests that a wall encloses
the forbidden land. None are allowed entry or egress.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
まずは近くまで行き、現在の状況を
実際にこの目で確かめるとしましょう。
text.official_en:
We will be able to see for ourselves once we draw
near enough.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
とりあえず、ここにある門が壁の出入り口
であることに間違いはなさそうですが……
text.official_en:
I am certain beyond doubt that the gate here is
intended as the passage through the wall.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
こりゃまた、ものっすごくでっかいね。
どうやったら開くのかな、これ？
text.official_en:
Wow, that's big. How is anyone supposed to
get it open?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
フムン。私の見たところ、この門は
数百年にわたり作動した形跡が無いようです。
text.official_en:
From the look of it, that very question has stymied
would-be travelers for centuries.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ディートリヒ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
だが、実際に壁を越えて
出てきたものがいる……そうだな？
text.official_en:
Yet we know at least some have penetrated the
defenses, do we not?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ええ。恐らく他に出入り口があるはずです。
それを探すことにしましょう。
text.official_en:
Indeed. It suggests there is another means of access.
Let us search.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
やはり、ありましたね。
恐らく、コンロンに所属する者たちは、
text.official_en: As I thought, there is an ingress. And here it is.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ここから壁を出入りしていると見て
間違いありません。
text.official_en:
The people of Kunlun must use it to access
their territory.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
さあ、ディートリヒ、
<#CTRL:0E>
text.official_en: Come, Dietrich. It is high time we <#CTRL:0E>

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
壁が光って、まるで生きてるみたいな通路……
この間のハンニバルとかのところと似てるね。
text.official_en:
The walls are glowing... It's like the corridor is alive!
Reminds me of when we met Hannibal.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
フムン……ここの機能は
完全には停止していないようですね。
text.official_en: This place also retains some functionality, it seems.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp: さあ、<#CTRL:0E>
text.official_en:
Come. We will see with our own eyes what
lies inside.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミカエラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
なんだい、あの長くて気持ち悪いのは……
こっちを狙ってやがるよ！
text.official_en: What is that huge thing? It's after us!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
成る程……これも、禁断の地に踏み込むための
試練といったところでしょうか。
text.official_en:
I see... I imagine this is a trial set for those who seek
entry to the forbidden land.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
避ける道も、探せば見つかるでしょうが……
どうしますか？　ディートリヒ。
text.official_en:
I suppose we could find an alternate path if we tried.
What say you, Dietrich?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ディートリヒ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ふふふ……鎧を着た蛇とは、面白い。
私の渇き……満たさせてもらおう！
text.official_en:
Heh. An armored snake? Interesting. I will slake
my thirst upon it!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ディートリヒ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……終わったか。
まだ物足りぬな……
text.official_en: It is over. Yet still I thirst.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ダーリンって、本当に戦うのが好きなんだね。
あたいは正直、そろそろ疲れてきたよ。
text.official_en:
You sure do love fighting, Sweetie. Honestly, I'm
getting tired.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミカエラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ねえ、ファビオ、
ここらで少し休んでいかないかい？
text.official_en:
For my part, I think it's high time for a rest. What
say you, Fabio?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
構いませんが、その必要はないかもしれません。
出口は、恐らくもう間もなくでしょうから。
text.official_en:
I do not mind, particularly, but it may not be needed.
The exit is likely just ahead.
